provenance: Synthetic case-author decisions for this demo; no claim of automatically proving natural-language prose equivalent to Lean.
workflow: Repair the contradictions first, compare live readings, then freeze ISA and cycle semantics. Mutations are applied only to private RTL copies.

decisions.decision: Little endian: word 0x11223344 at byte address zero yields 0x44.
LH sign extends; LHU zero extends.
SB/SH preserve every unselected byte and every other word.
Every reset preserves RAM; a nonzero word stays nonzero. Reset suppresses pending writes.
Asynchronous reads see pre-edge RAM; successful WB stores commit at the edge. Backend memory operations serialize.
Alignment precedes range; codes 1..4; fault preserves PC/regs/RAM and halts until reset.
Sample delay once at EX-to-MEM transfer; external MEM stall freezes its countdown.
Retire fault once, explicitly abort younger accepted work; do not require younger retirement after halt.
Arbitrary permanent stalls are legal; remove unconditional completion deadline.

limits: Eight clause-local contexts and a finite projected observation universe; not exhaustive enumeration of CPU executions.
revised_determined is about this finite diagnostic projection.
The independent ISA and cycle semantics are the proof targets; no NL parser correctness theorem is claimed.
